Allele features per cell and region

Source: R/features.R
allelic_features.Rd

Votes summed per cell and region (molecule start inside the region) after orienting the phase blocks: chromosome = plain sums (chromosome-wide anchored phase; orient = "anchored"); loo = orient_blocks() (orient = "pseudobulk" without groups, "clone" with groups); mirrored = block orientation marginalised ( f = the grid MLE f_mirror, nA / nB = the block-wise majority / minority votes; orient = "none"); auto = chromosome when detect_phasing() finds chromosome-wide phase sets, else loo. Regions with allelic_ok = FALSE are skipped.

Usage

allelic_features(
  votes,
  atoms,
  regions,
  orientation = c("auto", "chromosome", "loo", "mirrored"),
  groups = NULL,
  rho = NULL,
  params = caller_defaults(),
  exclude_atoms = NULL
)

Arguments

votes

votes table

atoms

atoms table

regions

regions table

orientation

"auto", "chromosome", "loo" or "mirrored"

groups

NULL or one group label per cell (see orient_blocks())

rho

beta-binomial overdispersion for mirrored (NULL: fitted on the blocks of null regions with at least 2 votes, at most 2e6 seeded rows)

params

caller_defaults() (eps, seed)

exclude_atoms

NULL or atom ids whose votes are dropped before the region sums (an allelic mask of overdispersed tiles, allelic_noisy_tiles()); orientation and block logic are otherwise unchanged

Value

data.table cell (index), region, nA, nB, n_hap, n_blocks, f, orient; attribute rho for mirrored
